questions.question: A FastAPI application must handle DELETE /items/{item_id}. Which decorator fits?
questions.explanation: The delete decorator registers that method and path.

questions.question: Given @app.get('/items/{item_id}') and def read(item_id: int, limit: int = 20), where does limit come from?
questions.explanation: A singular parameter that is not part of the path is a query parameter by default.

questions.question: A POST handler takes order: Order, where Order subclasses Pydantic BaseModel. Where does FastAPI normally read order?
questions.explanation: A Pydantic model parameter is interpreted as a request body.

questions.question: A client requests /items/oops when the path parameter is declared as int. What does FastAPI's default validation return?
questions.explanation: The route matches, but path parameter validation fails with 422.

questions.question: Which are suitable responsibilities for reusable Depends() dependencies? Select all that apply.

options.a: Validate the current session and return the user
options.c: Provide a resource with request-scoped cleanup
options.d: Generate a random response status for every request

questions.explanation: Dependencies can share authentication or resource lifecycle logic across routes.

questions.question: A handler returns user data that includes a password hash. Which route option can filter that data to a model named PublicUser?
questions.explanation: The response model controls validation and filtering of the serialized response.

questions.question: A lookup finds no matching invoice. How should the handler send a 404 with a detail message?
questions.explanation: Raising HTTPException lets FastAPI render the supplied HTTP status and detail.

questions.question: An APIRouter has a GET path '/'. Which call mounts it at /invoices/?
questions.explanation: include_router applies the prefix to routes declared on the router.

questions.question: Which FastAPI constructor option moves Swagger UI to /reference?
questions.explanation: docs_url controls the Swagger UI endpoint.

questions.question: Which parameter declarations request the listed source? Select all that apply.

options.a: Query() for a URL query parameter
options.b: Header() for an HTTP request header

questions.explanation: Query and Header explicitly select query and header inputs respectively.

questions.question: Why can calling time.sleep(1) directly inside an async route delay unrelated requests handled by the same event loop?

options.d: It suspends only that coroutine and releases the thread

questions.explanation: time.sleep blocks its thread. An asynchronous wait lets other coroutines run.

questions.question: Which helper can call FastAPI endpoints from tests without starting a separate network server?
questions.explanation: TestClient exercises the ASGI application in the test process.

questions.question: How can a test substitute a fake provider for a dependency function named get_store?
questions.explanation: The dependency overrides map replaces the dependency callable for tests.

questions.question: A separate browser origin needs permission to read API responses. Which middleware can configure that policy?
questions.explanation: CORS middleware sets the access-control headers used by browsers.

questions.question: Which are appropriate uses of FastAPI BackgroundTasks? Select all that apply.

options.a: Schedule a small follow-up after sending the response
options.b: Guarantee work survives every server restart
options.c: Run an in-process audit write after the response
options.d: Replace a durable queue for critical multi-hour jobs

questions.explanation: BackgroundTasks run after response delivery within the application process.

questions.question: Which parameter type provides the uploaded filename plus an underlying file-like object?
questions.explanation: UploadFile exposes upload metadata and a spooled temporary file.

questions.question: What mechanism can initialize a shared resource before requests and release it at shutdown?

options.a: A query parameter with a default
options.d: An async context manager passed as lifespan

questions.explanation: The lifespan context manager wraps application startup and shutdown.

questions.question: Which declaration allows page_size to default to 20 and limits it to the inclusive range 1 through 100?
questions.explanation: ge and le enforce inclusive lower and upper bounds for a query parameter.

questions.question: A POST creates an item successfully. Which decorator argument declares the normal response status as 201?
questions.explanation: The status_code argument sets the operation's normal response status.

questions.question: Which default endpoints expose interactive API documentation and its machine-readable schema? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: FastAPI serves Swagger UI at /docs and the OpenAPI document at /openapi.json by default.
